free_text: The patient is a 60-year-old male with a PSA of 6.8 ng/mL and a prior biopsy Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2). MRI revealed a focal lesion in the left peripheral zone with restricted diffusion and early enhancement, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was identified. Given the documented grade and stage, the management assessment focuses on the trade-off between active treatment and surveillance, pending clinical review of individual treatment benefit and patient preferences.
